patch.value: GH-1613: preserve typed PmClient validation and lookup refusals

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1613 on published2026.10.27 shows PmClient update validation and get not-found refusals throwing PmCliError with undefined code and empty context, while the equivalent CLI envelope has a stable code. Provide SDK-owned classification and structured field/value/allowed or item-ID facts, using SDK option names and retaining existing claim and document-parse contracts. This reported behavior has not been independently reproduced in this delivery; no implementation or repair is claimed.

Reproduce the three published validation/lookup cases in isolated owned trackers; preserve custom-schema allowed values and existing typed claim/document-parse behavior; expose stable codes plus structured field/value/allowed or ID facts without prose inference or sensitive-value leaks; add meaningful CLI-to-SDK conformance and packed Node/Bun consumer controls, failing before and passing after the repair.
Let package authors and self-improving agents handle public SDK refusals without parsing English messages
Public PmClient validation/lookup consumers and CLI/MCP refusal parity
Public PmClient validation and not-found refusals carry the same stable code as equivalent CLI envelopes, with specific structured context and SDK-oriented messages derived from active contracts.
